_README: UNVERIFIED PLACEHOLDER RATES. Verify every figure against the provider's
current pricing page before quoting any number this harness produces.
Model names and prices move faster than this file will be maintained, and a
unit-economics claim built on a stale rate is worse than no claim at all.
inputPerMillionUsd is the INPUT token price only. Compression reduces input
tokens; it does not change output pricing, so output rates are irrelevant to
the arbitrage and are deliberately omitted.
Add or replace entries freely -- the harness reads whatever is here.
